references.title: Create and configure scheduling link
references.take: Scheduling link configuration editor enables timezone selection, branding, booking form customization, and activation workflow.

references.title: Daily Meeting Summary
references.take: Scheduled automation setup from template picker to flow editor creates recurring email summaries of calendar meetings with test and enable controls.

references.title: Daily Meeting Summary Test
references.take: Manual test run for scheduled automation with history timeline showing integration progress, reasoning steps, and run initialization states.

references.title: Create and send email broadcast
references.take: Email broadcast creation with template selection, recipient segmentation, send confirmation modal, and immediate post-send analytics display.

references.title: Member Activity Report Generation
references.take: Admin activity report generation with optional filters and confirmation dialog showing report is queued for delivery to admin.

references.title: Activity Log Filtering
references.take: Audit activity log with person-based filter picker for narrowing event list to specific user's activities across time.

references.title: Analytics segment exploration
references.take: Filter and pivot analytics by segment (tag, time range, country, device) with visible filter chips and updated KPI cards showing narrowed results.

references.title: Client Import/Export
references.take: CSV import for batch client upload with column mapping preview, import confirmation, and success banner showing added records in client list.
